visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a dark, glossy braised pork knuckle topped with a sprig of fresh cilantro in a dark sauce. Festive text overlays appear at the top and bottom. A male hand is seen slicing into the meat with a knife, revealing the succulent interior. (2) A man with short dark hair wearing a forest green t-shirt appears in a brightly lit studio setting. He holds a white plate with the braised pork knuckle and gestures towards it with a smile. The background features white brick walls and red decorative banners with Chinese characters. (3) In a series of overhead cooking shots, white diced mushrooms are poured into a light grey frying pan and sautéed using a blue spatula. Diced onions, garlic, and red tomatoes are added sequentially. The lighting is bright and direct, casting soft shadows in the pan. (4) A clear liquid and a dark brown glossy sauce are poured into the pan from clear bowls. Yellow penne pasta is then added and stirred into the bubbling sauce. The camera remains static and close to the pan to focus on the textures of the ingredients. (5) White milk is poured into the pan, followed by pre-cooked chunks of braised pork knuckle and a small cube of butter. The mixture is stirred until creamy. Pink heart emojis appear on screen as the man in the green shirt tastes the dish with a fork. (6) The final dish is shown plated on a white ceramic plate, with the pasta and pork knuckle garnished with red peppers and herbs. A graphic screen follows, showing multiple dishes in the meal set, price information, and a QR code against a yellow and cream background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, festive Chinese-style music with electronic beats begins. A male voice speaks in a friendly, high-energy tone, introducing a braised pork knuckle dish. The acoustic environment is very clean, characteristic of a professional recording studio with no background noise. (2) A sharp, percussive "whoosh" transition sound effect occurs. The male voice continues his explanation of the dish's flavor profile. The background music maintains a steady tempo with synthesized strings and a clear rhythmic beat. (3) A distinct sizzling sound of food frying in a pan is heard as the male voice transitions to the cooking tutorial. He details the use of mushrooms with an animated and clear delivery. The ambient noise floor is silent except for the intentional cooking sounds. (4) A liquid pouring sound effect, characterized by a splashing acoustic texture, signals the addition of water. The male voice explains the simmering process, maintaining moderate pitch and high articulation clarity. (5) A percussive clattering sound of dry pasta hitting a pan is audible. The male voice describes the pasta preparation. The music provides a rhythmic bed under the speech, with electronic drums and bright melodic tones creating a positive atmosphere. (6) A soft splash and a series of wet thuds are heard as milk and meat are added to the pan. The male voice's intensity increases as he nears the end of the recipe. (7) A loud "Mmm" sound and light chewing noises indicate the tasting phase. The male voice expresses excitement with a higher pitch. A sparkle-like sound effect emphasizes the positive reaction. (8) A transition to a promotional segment features a voiceover listing menu items. The music remains the same but the vocal tone becomes more professional and narrative. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Demonstration -> Review -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a Chinese New Year meal set by demonstrating a creative leftover recipe. It starts by showcasing a premium braised pork knuckle, then addresses the common issue of having leftovers by showing how to transform them into a creamy penne pasta dish, ending with a direct purchase call for the set.
